race.comment: STUNTMAN (2) hasn't raced since finishing fourth at Ballarat over 2000m six weeks ago. Kept ticking over with a recent trial win at Horsham and looks poised to get a dream run from the inside alley. VESPASIAN (5) has raced consistently this campaign and got a richly deserved win last start, when he thrashed them by five lengths. This is tougher, but he'll put himself on speed and give a sight. TIERRA (10) has been out of the winner's list for a long time, last start finishing eighth at Ballarat over 1600m. Finds a suitable assignment and can turn things around. SUPERSTOCK (1) has registered two minor placings from three runs this campaign. Continued the trend last time out when third over 2025m at Cranbourne. Must be included in this sort of form. OLNEY (7) disappointed two back but hit back with an improved performance last start and gets blinkers here, which might spark further improvement.
